name: automagik-workspace
description: One Automagik workspace in its own virtual machine (Debian 13 cloud image; 2 CPUs, 4GiB, 20GiB): the Automagik server, its gate (the same image) and a Cloudflare Tunnel connector (cloudflared 2026.10.7), by digest, sharing one loopback. In a copy of this template set settings.publicUrl and the three Cloudflare Access settings. Created stopped: set TUNNEL_TOKEN, then instance_start.
